factual_technical_accuracy.rationale: Misleading category and adhesive generalizations; unsupported ROI

executive_summary.strengths: Describes formats, use cases, customization and a basic buying process; relevant links to label and sticker products.
executive_summary.critical_findings: Overstates label–sticker distinctions and savings; uses absolute material, adhesive and company-service claims without supporting conditions; contains clumsy sales copy.
executive_summary.recommended_corrections: Correct category definitions and seal/adhesive claims; qualify cost/ROI assertions; include substrate, adhesive, finish, artwork and proof details; edit repeated sales language.
